newsitem.title: RWANDA: Heavy fighting heard near east Zaire city of Goma.
newsitem.headline: Heavy fighting heard near east Zaire city of Goma.

text.p: Fighting raged on Wednesday near the city of Goma just inside Zaire between the Zairean army and rebels, a Reuters correspondent reported.

"We have been hearing very heavy firing from the other side of the border. The fighting is moving closer to Kibumba camp, including heavy mortar fire, automatic weapons and small arms fire," said correspondent Christian Jennings in the Rwandan border town of Gisenyi.
"This seems to be the Zairean army hitting rebel positions as they move closer to Kibumba and to Goma," said Rwandan Major Emmanuel Karemera.
It was not immediately clear who now held Kibumba camp, attacked by rebels last Friday and Saturday. Refugees streamed from the camp over the weekend, when it was effectively in rebel-held territory.
Jennings said he estimated that the firing was within about 10 km (six miles) of Goma, a major centre for aid efforts to feed hundreds of thousands of Rwandan refugees.
Residents said the firing was the heaviest heard in Gisenyi since fighting between the Zairean army and Tutsi rebels exploded earlier this month.
There was no sign of any cross-border firing, Jennings said.
